feature_constraint: Exactly one named Transformer second-stage reconstructed feature per modality: std, edge_density, edge_density
risk_model: standardized univariate logistic regression calibrated on named Transformer second-stage reconstructions
weight_formula: manual fixed policy: time_series=0.20, optical=0.40, sonar=0.40

image_preprocessing.edge_policy: anchor the final tile to the right or bottom edge
image_preprocessing.tile_count_policy: derive from each input image's original dimensions
image_preprocessing.image_risk_aggregation: mean of all calibrated tile probabilities

time_series.weight_source: fixed engineering policy: image modalities jointly carry 80 percent
time_series.validation_dataset: USGS MATANZAS five-sensor aligned ocean sequences with controlled drift and spikes
time_series.positive_label: controlled sensor-scale drift and sparse spikes

optical_image.weight_source: fixed engineering policy: image modalities jointly carry 80 percent
optical_image.positive_label: raw or challenging degraded underwater image
optical_image.risk_interpretation: edge-density proxy for optical clarity and structural visibility

sonar_image.weight_source: fixed engineering policy: image modalities jointly carry 80 percent
sonar_image.validation_dataset: Real XTF side-scan ping image with controlled blur and contrast loss
sonar_image.positive_label: controlled blur and contrast loss on real XTF intensity
sonar_image.risk_interpretation: edge-density proxy for sonar structural visibility

calibration_context_policy: each target-modality row is reconstructed through CLS while every other modality is represented by its current-split mean
